info.description:
APIPie.ai is the unified API for building and scaling agentic AI workflows.  

Access models, internet search, vector search, document parsing powered by Apache Tika, and pseudonymization powered by Presidio through a single platform designed for automation.  

Ingest, structure, and secure company data to power RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, and end-to-end business workflows without stitching together fragmented tools.  

Enrich your systems with external data sources for search, market intelligence, and competitive analysis, all accessible on demand.  

APIPie.ai is fully usage-based—pay only for what you use, with no upfront cost or wasted infrastructure.

Using APIpie requires the use of an API key, [click here to create an API key and get started](https://apipie.ai/profile/api-keys).

get.description:
The Inline CLI lets you embed `:command` tokens directly inside your chat prompt to dynamically
control API settings — model selection, internet search, memory, response shaping, and integrity —
all without any extra API calls.

**How to enable:** include `inline_cli: "all"` (or a comma-separated list of feature groups) in
your `/v1/chat/completions` request body. Then embed `:command` tokens anywhere in your prompt text.
Commands are parsed before the LLM call and applied to the request.

**Feature groups:** `model`, `shaping`, `integrity`, `internet`, `memory`, `information`

**State integration:** Commands that include `set` (e.g. `:setmodel`, `:setmemoryon`,
`:setsearchlang`) automatically persist their changes to the API key state via the State API,
so subsequent requests inherit the updated configuration without re-sending the command.

**NLP mode:** When NLP is enabled in state, the LLM itself can interpret natural language
instructions and emit the appropriate `:command` tokens, enabling fully conversational control
of API settings by your agent.

---

### Information Commands
> Direct commands — the prompt is **not** forwarded to the LLM

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `:getstate` | Returns the current API key state as a JSON response. |
| `:help` | Returns this command reference. |

---

### Model Commands
> Switch which model handles this request, persistently or for one query

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `:setmodel:<provider>/<model>` | Persistently set the model (saved to state). |
| `:unsetmodel` | Clear the persistent model override. |
| `:answerwith<name>` | Use a named model for this query only. Options: `openai`, `gpt`, `anthropic`, `claude`, `grok`, `llama`, `gemini`, `deepseek`, `mistral`, `mixtral`, `smart`, `cheap`, `coding`. |

---

### Shaping Commands
> Adjust temperature, top_p, and penalty settings

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `:beprecise` | temperature=0.2, top_p=0.5 |
| `:bebalanced` | temperature=0.5, top_p=0.8 |
| `:becreative` | temperature=0.9, top_p=0.95 |
| `:becrazy` | temperature=1.5, top_p=1.0 |
| `:becoder` | temperature=0.1, top_p=0.4, penalties=0 |
| `:avoidrepeat` | frequency_penalty=1.2 |
| `:answerdiverse` | presence_penalty=1.2 |
| `:stayontopic` | presence_penalty=0, frequency_penalty=0 |

---

### Integrity Commands
> Reduce hallucinations by querying multiple times and selecting the best answer

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `:unsetintegrity` | Disable integrity mode. |
| `:setintegrity` | Enable integrity (best of 2) — saved to state. |
| `:setsuperintegrity` | Enable super integrity (best of 3) — saved to state. |
| `:answerintegrity` | Enable integrity for this query only. |
| `:answersuperintegrity` | Enable super integrity for this query only. |

---

### Internet Search Commands
> Augment the prompt with live web search results before sending to the LLM

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `:search` | Low-depth web search (1 query, 1 result). |
| `:searchmore` | Medium-depth web search (2 queries, 2 results each). |
| `:deepsearch` | High-depth web search (4 queries, 2 results each). |
| `:setsearchlang:<code>` | Set search language (2-letter ISO code, e.g. `en`). Saved to state. |
| `:setsearchgeo:<code>` | Set search geography (2-letter country code, e.g. `US`). Saved to state. |

---

### Memory Commands
> Control conversation memory (stored in vector DB, keyed by session)

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `:setmemoryon` | Enable memory for this session. Saved to state. |
| `:setmemoryoff` | Disable memory. Saved to state. |
| `:clearmemory` | Clear all stored memory for the current session. |
| `:setmemexpire:<minutes>` | Set memory TTL in minutes (5–1440). Saved to state. |

inline_cli.description: Command to enable or disable inline CLI features. Can be boolean true/false or a comma-delimited string of features like all, disabled, information, integrity, memory, model, search, shaping.  send :help in your prompt for more details

model.description: Language Model to use, comma separated, up to 5 models. Check our /models route for list of language models. Cannot use provider option with multi-model.

provider.description: AI Service Provider to use, omit provider and we will automatically use the most responsive provider. Optionally you can include provider with the model instead such as model: provider/model

vector_provider.description: Vector provider to use to store memory and rag tune data, make sure to use the same provider per collection/session.

memory.description: Enable Integrated Model Memory to maintain conversation context. Set to true to enable memory for this conversation, the default is false.

mem_session.description: Optional unique identifier for maintaining separate memory chains for different users/applications. If not provided, a default session is used.

mem_expire.description: Optional time in minutes after which stored memories will automatically expire and be deleted.

mem_clear.description: Set to 1 to instantly delete all stored memories for the specified mem_session.

mem_msgs.description: Maximum number of messages to append from memory to the user provided prompts. The default is 8 additional messages

mem_length.description: Percentage (1-100) of model's max response tokens to use for memory. For example, 20 on a 100k max response tokens model would allow up to 20k tokens for memory augmentation. The default is 20%

shortMem.description: Number of recent user–assistant message pairs to keep in short-term memory (state cache). Each pair equals 2 messages. Max: 10 pairs (20 messages). Default: 3.

longMem.description: Number of individual messages to retrieve from long-term memory (vector similarity search). Max: 10 messages. Default: 2.

rag_tune.description: Specify the name of the rag tune or vector collection to be used for RAG tuning. This will augment the language model query with information from the specified vector database.

routing.description: Define how we should route your call when you do not specify a provider and multiple providers exist for that model. Options are price (cheapest), multi-tiered performance (routing based on lowest latency for prompt size) and average_latency. The default is perf (price/perf/perf_avg)

temperature.description: Influences the randomness in the selection process of the next token. Lower values make the model more deterministic, while higher values increase diversity but might reduce coherence.

top_p.description: Controls the cumulative probability distribution cutoff, selecting the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds the threshold p. This focuses generation on more likely tokens, enhancing creativity and coherence.

top_k.description: Limits the selection pool to the top k most probable tokens. The probability distribution is then reranked among these k tokens, which helps in reducing randomness by eliminating the least likely options.

frequency_penalty.description: Adjusts the likelihood of a token's selection based on its previous occurrences, decreasing the chances of frequently selected tokens to promote diversity in the output.

presence_penalty.description: Similar to frequency penalty, but it decreases the likelihood of tokens appearing again based on their presence, regardless of frequency, to encourage novel token selection.

repetition_penalty.description: Discourages the model from repeating the same words or phrases, enhancing the uniqueness and variety of the content generated.

n.description: receive this many responses to your prompt, currently only works with OpenAI direct

beam_size.description: Used in beam search, it represents the number of sequences to keep at each step of the generation. A larger beam size increases the chances of finding a more optimal sequence but at the cost of computational resources and time. Only some models support this

search_whitelist.description: Array of root FQDNs to allow for AI search (e.g., ["apnews.com", "bbc.com", "reuters.com"]). If not provided/null, AI can use any URLs that searches present. Applies to all search-augmented completions. Backward compatible: strings (comma-delimited) are also accepted and will be converted to arrays.

search_blacklist.description: Array of root FQDNs to block for AI search (e.g., ["cnn.com", "foxnews.com"]). If not provided/null, no URLs are blocked. Applies to all search-augmented completions. Backward compatible: strings (comma-delimited) are also accepted and will be converted to arrays.

web_search_options.description: Options for web search context size using Valyu search provider. Controls the amount of search content provided to the model. Defaults to low.

search_context_size.description:
- low: 1 search query, 1 result per query
- medium: 2 search queries, 2 results per query (4 total contents)
- high: 4 search queries, 2 results per query (8 total contents)

search_provider.description: Search provider to use for inline internet augmentation. Can be "valyu" or "google". Default is "valyu".

stream_errors.description:
Controls how errors are returned when using streaming responses. Defaults to true.
- If true (default), all streaming error messages are sent in the message body, which is commonly used for browser clients.
- If false, errors are thrown and not streamed in the response body. This may not be as comprehensive in some cases where the error happens after the stream starts.

source_biases.description: Bias values for specific sources to influence ranking without hard filtering. Keys are domains (e.g., "nasa.gov") or URL paths. Values are integers from -5 (strong demotion) to +5 (strong boost).

response_length.description: valyu | Controls the length of content returned per result. Can be an integer for character count or predefined values: short (25k), medium (50k), large (100k), max (full)

search_whitelist.description: Array of root FQDNs to allow for AI search (e.g., ["apnews.com", "bbc.com", "reuters.com"]). If not provided/null, AI can use any URLs that searches present. Applies to all search-augmented completions. Backward compatible: strings (comma-delimited) are also accepted and will be converted to arrays.

search_blacklist.description: Array of root FQDNs to block for AI search (e.g., ["cnn.com", "foxnews.com"]). If not provided/null, no URLs are blocked. Applies to all search-augmented completions. Backward compatible: strings (comma-delimited) are also accepted and will be converted to arrays.

temperature.description: Influences the randomness in the selection process of the next token. Lower values make the model more deterministic, while higher values increase diversity but might reduce coherence.

top_p.description: Controls the cumulative probability distribution cutoff, selecting the smallest set of tokens whose cumulative probability exceeds the threshold p. This focuses generation on more likely tokens, enhancing creativity and coherence.

top_k.description: Limits the selection pool to the top k most probable tokens. The probability distribution is then reranked among these k tokens, which helps in reducing randomness by eliminating the least likely options.

frequency_penalty.description: Adjusts the likelihood of a token's selection based on its previous occurrences, decreasing the chances of frequently selected tokens to promote diversity in the output.

presence_penalty.description: Similar to frequency penalty, but it decreases the likelihood of tokens appearing again based on their presence, regardless of frequency, to encourage novel token selection.

web_search_options.description: Options for web search context size, can be set to low, medium, or high. Defaults to low. Overrides any settings for search, pull, use, and scrape length.

tags.name: Parser
tags.description: Parse and extract structured content from documents using Apache Tika. Supports a wide range of file formats for ingestion into RAG pipelines, search systems, and downstream AI workflows.

tags.name: Anon
tags.description: Pseudonymize and protect sensitive data using Presidio-powered anonymization. Detect and redact PII from text before processing, storage, or model interaction.

tags.name: State
tags.description: Manage API key-based configuration state. Predefine reusable configurations that control parameters, models, and behavior across requests, enabling consistent and automated agent workflow capability even when the tools themselves dont support it.

tags.name: InlineCli
tags.description: Just send `:help` in the first part of the user prompt with API or a chat client using our api to get a help menu. Enable your agentic AI to control the API options and features through the prompt itself. Make any workflow agent more powerful with the APIpie Inline-CLI. Control models, search, memory, shaping, hallucination protection and more — all without extra API calls and empowering your AI Agent to take its ability to the next level through the prompt itself. Only at APIpie.ai
